correctness.rationale: PASS: A direct finite endpoint computation establishes the first repetition and unique earlier matching position at both ends of each of 25 intervals covering all integer n from 1 to 8192. Monotonicity of collision position and existence of the same collision at the larger endpoint prove every interior value. The word is generated independently by a four-state uniform substitution and by base-2 zero-run arithmetic; the 50 direct endpoint decisions use all-candidates hash bucketing followed by exact memcmp. Observed endpoint run: VERIFY_OK M=8192 intervals=25 boundary_cases=50. Scope is finite; no extrapolation.

Non-indexed equivalent work remains a risk; search nonhits alone are not novelty proof.

value.rationale: PASS: This is a complete exact classification of a canonical prefix-sensitive complexity invariant over 8192 consecutive factor lengths through a natural 2-power cutoff. The 25 maximal plateaux include every sharp transition and its unique matching earlier position, distinguishing two dyadically scaled collision regimes. It is more informative than mere prefix generation or ordinary factor counts and supplies a reproducible stringent finite test bed for any future infinite-state or regularity theorem. The specific cutoff is explicit and no global theorem is claimed.
